descripcion: Factors for translating kgCO2eq into tangible quantities in the report. Electrical ones are expressed as consumption in kWh and converted with the project's current emission factor, so they never drift out of sync with the EF in use.

electricas.detalle: ~10 Wh battery charged from the grid

vehiculares.fuente_consumo: GFEI / UN Environment, baseline study of light-duty vehicle fuel efficiency in Argentina (2018), covering vehicles registered between 2006 and 2017
vehiculares.combustible: Grade 2 (Premium) gasoline with 12% bioethanol, fossil CO₂
vehiculares.fuente_factor: Sistema Nacional de Inventario de GEI de Argentina (SNIGEIAR, Argentina's national greenhouse gas inventory system), Factores de Emisión para huella de carbono 2025 (emission factors for carbon footprint 2025), Subsecretaría de Ambiente de la Nación (Argentina's national Environment Undersecretariat), Table 2 "Combustibles - Transporte" (Fuels - Transport)
vehiculares.nota: The per-km factor is computed as consumption × fuel factor, with Argentine data for both terms. Only fossil CO₂ is counted: Argentine gasoline contains 12% bioethanol by regulation, and its biogenic CO₂ (0.1795 kgCO₂/L, i.e. 14.2 gCO₂/km) is reported separately, following the practice of the national inventory.

arboles.detalle: annual absorption of a mature tree, reference value adopted by this work
annual absorption of a newly planted tree, reference value adopted by this work
